}}'''Afara''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Afara}}

== Strength and Abilities ==
Afara is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|very weak]] in the [[One Power]], with a strength level of {{opsl|40}}. This is marginally above [[Siuan Sanche]]'s strength after she was healed from [[Stilling|Severing]].

==Activities==
After the [[White Tower Schism]], she joined the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]].

[[Sheriam Bayanar]] and the [[Salidar Six]] send Afara, [[Edesina Azzedin]] and [[Guisin]] to [[Tarabon]] as emissaries of the Rebel faction{{ref/book|6|15}}.

All three were captured by the [[Seanchan]] and made ''[[damane]]''. Afara was left behind in Tanchico when Edesina and Guisin were taken to [[Ebou Dar]].
